[Script]
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/script\.hub\/($|edit\/|reload)/i then script("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Script-Hub-Org/Script-Hub/502cf03f7db2e077d96c07c2cb151a8f0b152a80/script-hub.js") with tag="Script Hub: 前端", timeout=300

request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/script\.hub\/file\/_start_\/(?![\s\S]*\/_end_(?=\/)[\s\S]*\/_end_\/)(?:(?!file\/_start_\/)[^\s#])+\/_end_\/[^\/?&#\s]+\?(?:(?!type=)[A-Za-z0-9_.~-]+=(?:[^%&#?\s]|%[A-Fa-f0-9][A-Fa-f0-9])*&)*type=(?:qx-rewrite|surge-module|loon-plugin|all-module)(?:&(?!type=)[A-Za-z0-9_.~-]+=(?:[^%&#?\s]|%[A-Fa-f0-9][A-Fa-f0-9])*)*(?![\s\S])/ then script("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Script-Hub-Org/Script-Hub/502cf03f7db2e077d96c07c2cb151a8f0b152a80/Rewrite-Parser.js") with tag="Script Hub: 重写转换", timeout=300

request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/script\.hub\/file\/_start_\/(?![\s\S]*\/_end_(?=\/)[\s\S]*\/_end_\/)(?:(?!file\/_start_\/)[^\s#])+\/_end_\/[^\/?&#\s]+\?(?:(?!type=)[A-Za-z0-9_.~-]+=(?:[^%&#?\s]|%[A-Fa-f0-9][A-Fa-f0-9])*&)*type=rule-set(?:&(?!type=)[A-Za-z0-9_.~-]+=(?:[^%&#?\s]|%[A-Fa-f0-9][A-Fa-f0-9])*)*(?![\s\S])/ then script("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Script-Hub-Org/Script-Hub/502cf03f7db2e077d96c07c2cb151a8f0b152a80/rule-parser.js") with tag="Script Hub: 规则集转换", timeout=300

request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/script\.hub\/convert\//i then script("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Script-Hub-Org/Script-Hub/502cf03f7db2e077d96c07c2cb151a8f0b152a80/script-converter.js") with tag="Script Hub: 脚本转换", timeout=300

[MITM]
hostname = script.hub
